anonymous_trace_audit.trace_signature: opcode plus operand-class plus stack-effect; values, symbols, paths and source omitted

no_global_symbol_counterexample.shared_shape: RESUME; LOAD_CONST; RETURN_VALUE after runtime cache filtering
no_global_symbol_counterexample.reason: The anonymous trace omits the constant value, so identical candidate-visible programs require different exact outputs.

control_boundary_analysis.cpython_interpreter: Exact but privileged: it already contains the complete opcode, object-model, exception, call and import semantics.
control_boundary_analysis.hand_authored_bytecode_interpreter: Would place the essential instruction ontology in the evaluator or candidate and violate the gate.
control_boundary_analysis.bounded_finite_search: Can search macro segmentations only after execution semantics are supplied; it does not infer exact state transformations from anonymous traces.
control_boundary_analysis.sequitur_bpe_superinstructions: Can compress recurring trace strings but cannot identify the omitted semantic payload.
control_boundary_analysis.profile_guided_basic_block_cache: Can replay previously executed blocks but does not execute unseen state transformations and is an exact-cache control.
control_boundary_analysis.supplied_program_vm: Repeats EXP-20260830-0013's supplied-program limitation and does not test instruction discovery.

decision_reason: Real tracked modules and three scales exist, but the permitted anonymous representation is not an executable specification. Adding values and CPython semantics supplies the instruction ontology; omitting them makes exact held-out execution non-identifiable. The remaining tasks reduce to trace compression, exact caching or supplied-program execution, which existing controls and experiments already cover.
next_cycle: One minimal breadth service selection may freeze a genuinely different scout only if an existing cohort cannot express it; no more than two additional no-scoring cycles are allowed before a scored scout. Do not reopen repository bytecode superinstructions.
